A/p7.episode_summary: A PowerShell npm build failed on a type error; after an edit pnpm build succeeded.

facts.summary: Run the build through pnpm build instead of npm run build in this repository.
facts.details: npm run build (under PowerShell) failed with a TypeScript error until the source was fixed; pnpm build is the configured script.
facts.rationale: Failure followed by the pnpm equivalent succeeding.
